General Remarks

The land sold during the year amounted to 109,349.91 acres, which realized $279,293.67. The quantity of surrendered
land in the hands of the department was, approximately 337,078.21 acres. The principal outstanding, on account of
Indian Lands sold, amounted to $419,377.20, a considerable portion of which has not yet become due.

General Remarks

The land sold during the year amounted to 109,349.91 acres, which realized $279,293.67. The quantity of surrendered
land in the hands of the department was, approximately 337,078.21 acres. The principal outstanding, on account of
Indian Lands sold, amounted to $419,377.20, a considerable portion of which has not yet become due.
